Principle 3: Friend Introduction
I would like to introduce my friend to you.
/ Allow me to introduce my friend to you.
He is one of my best friends.
I am very outgoing, so I like to do many things with other people.
Because of this, I have many friends.
Their names are Dai-han (대한) and Min-guk(민국).
Who is my best friend?
My best friend is Dai-han, and I have known him for 3 years.
What is he like? He is like me in many ways.
He is an outgoing but sometimes shy person like me.
He likes to hang out and play with friends,
but he does not like to talk to new people. I am like this, too.
My friend has many talents.
He is an excellent piano player and very strong athlete.
In addition, he is good at playing the piano, soccer, computer games,
and she is good at speaking English.
He is a very talented artist, too.
Her drawings are very bright and colorful.
So I can learn a lot from him. He is my friend, and I am proud of him.
He always understands my problems, and when I need help,
he is always there.
He sometimes tells me that he wants to be a police officer, fire fighter,
teacher, doctor, interpreter, and he wants to serve the community.
He is a truly smart person, and I am sure that his dream will come true.
